title: Koalib people - Wikipedia
text: Koalib Nuba are an ethnic group, a part of the Nuba peoples that are indigenous to the Nuba Mountains of South Kordofan state, Sudan. They are amongst the largest Nuba ethnic groups numbering around 20,000 thousand in the 1940s and 44,258 thousand in 1984.
